name: devmesh
description: A provider-ready AI software engineering orchestration framework with Codex and ChatGPT adapters, Mission Control task graphs, parallel-agent orchestration, independent judging, confidence-aware diagnosis, adversarial review, impact mapping, failure memory, eval/replay benchmarking, architecture simulation, resource budgets, incident command, one-prompt full-stack builds, Browser QA, security, CI repair, deployment, and Git delivery.

interface.shortDescription: Mission Control for evidence-based AI software engineering
interface.longDescription: DevMesh v0.7 adds Mission Control: dynamic dependency graphs, real parallel delegation when available, independent judging, confidence-aware routing, adversarial design review, change-impact mapping, verified failure memory, eval/replay benchmarking, architecture simulation, resource budgets, and incident command on top of the existing full-stack, Browser QA, security, CI, production, review, reporting, and Git workflows. Codex uses the plugin adapter; ChatGPT uses the portable Agent Skills adapter.
defaultPrompt: DevMesh Mission Control: build this product end-to-end and judge the integrated result against evidence.
DevMesh Deep + Balanced: prepare this application for production.
DevMesh Incident Commander: investigate this production failure, stabilize it, prove the root cause, and verify recovery.
